newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Autoliv '96 profit to rise 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Autoliv '96 profit to rise 15 pct.

text.p: Swedish car safety equipment manufacturer Autoliv AB was expected to post a pre-tax profit of 1.16 billion crowns for 1996 compared to 1.01 billion crowns in 1995, a Reuters poll of 11 analysts found.
Forecasts varied between 1.13 billion crowns and 1.22 billion crowns.
Earnings per share were expected to come in at 13.80 crowns with a dividend of 2.60 crowns.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Carnegie, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Enskilda, Fiba, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Nordiska, Paribas and Swedbank.
Autoliv is due to release its 1996 result around midday.
